z-m-21-01.title: Isiphetho esithi "eyodwa kuphela": ingabe iyona eyodwa kuphela ngempela?
z-m-21-01.topic: Ukubhala isisho sezinga lesi-4 njengomkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic: ukuhlola yonke imihlobo engenzeka
z-m-21-01.goal: Hlola isiphetho esithi "eyodwa kuphela" esenziwe ngemva kokubheka amanye amacala angenzeka kuphela, yenza imikhiqizo ehlukene yezisho ze-quadratic yesisho esifanayo sezinga lesi-4 ukuze uqinisekise, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani inani lezindlela limiswa ngisho nalapho imibandela inwebiswa.
z-m-21-01.material: UJiho uthole indlela yokubhala u-x⁴−5x²+4 ngesimo (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d). Lapha i-coefficient ka-x² ingu-1 kuzo zombili izisho ze-quadratic, u-a, b, c, d yizinombolo eziphelele, futhi ukushintshanisa ukulandelana kwezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic (isibonelo, ukushintshanisa u-a, b no-c, d) kubalwa njengokuhlukanisa okufanayo. Ngemva kokuqeda ukuxazulula, uJiho wathi, "Kukhona ukuhlukanisa okunjalo okukodwa kuphela." Okulandelayo yisixazululo sikaJiho. (Indlela yokufunda: x⁴ ngu-"x kuya emandleni wesi-4", x² ngu-"x isikwele", futhi u-ac ngu-"a izikhathi c".)
z-m-21-01.thinking.0: Ukuthola umugqa lapho icala lashiywa khona
z-m-21-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo ezihlukene ezakho eziphula isiphetho
z-m-21-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlulela ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha kanjani uma umbandela ushintshwa (izinombolo eziphelele ziye ezinombolweni zangempela)
z-m-21-01.prereq.0: Ukunwebisa umkhiqizo wezisho ezimbili ze-quadratic nokuhlela amagama ezinga elifanayo (izinga leyunithi ye-polynomial kuMathematics Ejwayelekile, ibanga le-3 lesikole samabanga aphansi kuya ebangeni le-1 lesikole samabanga aphezulu)
z-m-21-01.prereq.1: Incazelo yokuthi ama-polynomial amabili asho isisho esifanayo ku-x (i-identity). Ukubekwa kwebanga kwalo msebenzi kuyincazelo yobunzima kuphela ngaphakathi kwe-batch yokukhiqiza futhi akusona isabelo sebanga ohlelweni lwezifundo
z-m-21-01.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokunwebisa umkhiqizo wezisho ze-linear ezifana no-(x−1), (x+1)
z-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umugqa owenza isiphetho sikaJiho esithi "eyodwa kuphela" sibe nzima ukusikholelwa njengoba sinjalo? Khetha umugqa owodwa.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngqo kumugqa ongaphambi kwawo, futhi kusukela emugqeni muni igama elithi "le yiyodwa kuphela" livela kuqala.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni owenza uhlu ngokuthi "ungomunye we-~", njengomugqa 4, yenza kabusha uhlu ngaphansi kombandela ofanayo futhi uqhathanise eyodwa ngeyodwa nohlu olubhalwe emugqeni.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.0: Nwebisa (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) futhi ufanise i-coefficient yezinga ngalinye ukuze ibe yisisho esifanayo no-x⁴−5x²+4.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.1: Kusukela ku-coefficient ka-x³, a+c=0, ngakho c=−a, futhi kusukela ku-coefficient ka-x, ad+bc=a(d−b)=0, ngakho a=0 noma b=d.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.3: U-b no-d bayizinombolo eziphelele futhi umkhiqizo wazo ungu-4, ngakho (b, d) ngomunye ka-(1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 2).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.4: Phakathi kwazo, kuphela okunelisa i-coefficient ka-x² b+d−a²=−5 ngu-b=d=2, a=3 (noma a=−3).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.explain: Ukubala emigqeni 1 kuya ku-3 kulungile (i-coefficient ka-x² ingu-b+d+ac, futhi njengoba c=−a, ingu-b+d−a²). Umugqa 4 yilapho kuqala ukuhamba kabi. Amapheya ezinombolo eziphelele anomkhiqizo ongu-4 afaka nawo (−1, −4), (−4, −1), (−2, −2), kodwa amapheya aphozithivu kuphela abhalwa. Umugqa 5 ulungile "ngaphakathi kohlu olubhaliwe", kodwa uhlu alugcwele, ngakho "eyodwa kuphela" emugqeni 6 ayinaso isisekelo. Noma ukhethe umugqa 6, inkinga akusikho ukubala kwalowo mugqa ngokwawo kodwa "ukuthi wonke amacala ahloliwe yini ngaphambilini".
z-m-21-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ukuhlukanisa okuhlukene okubili (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) okulingana no-x⁴−5x²+4. (a, b, c, d yizinombolo eziphelele. Lawo ahluka ngokulandelana kuphela abalwa njengokuhlukanisa okufanayo.)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza kabusha uhlu lwamanani ka-b, d esixazululweni sikaJiho wena, futhi ufake namapheya angekho ohlwini ezimeni ze-coefficient ezisele ukuze uhlole.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa kube ngamagatsha amabili, icala lika-a=0 nelika-b=d, futhi uthole amanani ka-b no-d kwelinye nelinye.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.ok.c0: U-a, b, c, d bonke bayizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c0: Sicela uthathe u-a, b, c, d njengezinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c1: I-coefficient ka-x³ (a+c) ngemva kokunwebisa asiyona u-0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c2: I-coefficient ka-x² (b+d+ac) ngemva kokunwebisa asiyona u-−5.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c3: I-coefficient ka-x (ad+bc) ngemva kokunwebisa asiyona u-0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Igama eliqhubekayo (bd) ngemva kokunwebisa asiyona u-4.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.explain: Kunokuhlukanisa okuthathu okungenzeka kwezinombolo eziphelele: (x²−1)(x²−4), (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2), no-(x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Ukuhlukanisa kukaJiho ngolunye lwazo nje. Lawo ahluka ngokulandelana kuphela, njengokushintshanisa u-a no-−a, abalwa njengokuhlukanisa okufanayo.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Uma amaqembu amabili ahlukene bobabili benza u-x⁴−5x²+4, isiphetho sikaJiho esithi "eyodwa kuphela" sahamba kabi kuphi? Bhala imisho emibili noma emithathu, usebenzisa okungenani esinye sezisho osanda kuzenza.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nwebisa ngalinye lamaqembu amabili owenzile futhi uqhathanise ukuthi imiphumela iyisisho esifanayo yini.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi uJiho wahlela kanjani amacala angenzeka nokuthi amaqembu owenzile aphakathi kohlu lwakhe yini.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole wena ukuthi isisho osinikeze siba ngempela u-x⁴−5x²+4 uma sinwebisiwe?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombe imbangela yephutha njenge-"ukushiya amacala angenzeka" kunokuba "iphutha lokubala"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubhale nokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe ukusho "eyodwa kuphela"?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukunwebisa (x²−1)(x²−4) kunika u-x⁴−5x²+4, futhi ukunwebisa (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) nakho kunika isisho esifanayo. Womabili amaqembu alungile, ngakho akusona kuphela eyodwa. UJiho washiya amapheya angeke aphozithivu phakathi kwamapheya ezinombolo eziphelele anomkhiqizo ongu-4, ngakho kwasala eyodwa kuphela.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Ikhuluma kokubili ngesibonelo esiphikisayo (elinye iqembu) nembangela (ukushiya amacala)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.1: U-x⁴−5x²+4 ungabhalwa njengo-(x−1)(x+1)(x−2)(x+2), ngakho kuye ngokuthi uhlanganisa kanjani izisho ezine ze-linear ngamapheya, kuphuma imikhiqizo eminingi yezisho ze-quadratic, njengo-(x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Isiphetho sikaJiho sivela ekutholeni indlela eyodwa kuphela ngaphandle kokuhlola wonke amacala.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Kuchazwe ngombono omunye, ukuhlanganisa izisho ze-linear
z-m-21-01.s.s3.prompt: Manje ake sinwebise umbandela othi "ama-coefficient ezinombolo eziphelele" ube "ama-coefficient ezinombolo zangempela" (izisho ezimbili ze-quadratic ezinoku-coefficient ka-x² engu-1; lezo ezihluka ngokulandelana kuphela ziyakuhlukanisa okufanayo). Imibandela ye-coefficient engenhla, a+c=0, a(d−b)=0, b+d−a²=−5, bd=4, ingasetshenziswa njengoba injalo. Yisiphi isitatimende esifaneleka kakhulu mayelana nenani lokuhlukanisa okungenzeka kulesi simo?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ku-a(d−b)=0, hlukanisa kube icala lika-a=0 nelika-b=d, futhi ubhale ama-equation asele kwelinye nelinye.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.1: Egatsheni ngalinye, xazulula ngqo bese ubala ukuthi u-b no-d bangathatha amanani amangaki uma beyizinombolo ezingempela.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.a: Kunezinombolo ezingempela eziningi kakhulu kunezinombolo eziphelele, ngakho kunokwehlukanisa okungenakubalwa
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.a: Lo mcabango ubona ukuthi uma izinombolo ezivunyelwe ziyanda, izimpendulo nazo ziyanda. Kodwa kulokhu, ungacabanga kuqala ukuthi izimo zama-coefficient zibophanisa kanjani u-a, b, c, d?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.b: Kusengu-3. Emagatsheni amabili (uma u-a=0 nalapho u-b=d), amanani asenqunyiwe kakade
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.b: Lesi isahlulelo esahlukanisa saba yimagatsha amabili futhi sahlola ukuthi amanani anqunyiwe ngaphakathi kwezinombolo ezingempela nazo.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.c: Kuyancipha uma kuqhathaniswa nezinombolo eziphelele. Izinombolo ezingempela zifaka izinombolo eziphelele, ngakho isimo siqine kakhulu
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.c: Uthole isiphetho esiphambene kusukela eqinisweni lokuthi "izinombolo ezingempela zifaka izinombolo eziphelele." Uma ibanga elivunyelwe liba banzi, ukwehlukanisa okungenzeka akunakwehla. Hlola ukuthi ezintathu ezivela ecaleni lezinombolo eziphelele zisasebenza yini.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.d: Izimo azanele, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi zingaki
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.d: Lesi sahlulelo sithi "ulwazi alwanele" ngaphandle kokubala ukuthi ama-equation amane anikeziwe anele yini. Hlola ukuthi izimiso ezingaziwa ezine nama-equation amane anciphisa amanani yini.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.explain: Njengoba u-a(d−b)=0, u-a=0 noma u-b=d. Uma u-a=0, khona-ke u-b+d=−5 no-bd=4, ngakho u-b no-d babili kuphela izimpande u-−1 no-−4 luka-t²+5t+4=0. Uma u-b=d, khona-ke u-b²=4 unika u-b=±2, futhi u-a²=2b+5, ngakho uma u-b=2, u-a=±3, futhi uma u-b=−2, u-a=±1. Ngisho nasezinombolweni ezingempela akukho okunye ngaphandle kwala magatsha, ngakho ukungazinaki izinombolo, kusengu-3. Isimo sokuba yinombolo ephelele asizange sibe nendima yokuhlunga kulesi simo.
